assumptions.choice: After the 50% take-profit order completes, the trailing-stop level is initialized to the 9-EMA and then ratchets upward only, using the highest subsequent 9-EMA value.
assumptions.reason: The specification states that the 9-EMA trailing stop automatically moves upward as price rises.

assumptions.choice: Candlestick body coverage and the 50% piercing threshold use inclusive comparisons; no unstated upper bound is imposed on the piercing candle close.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires complete coverage and a close at least 50% into the prior body, without requiring strict inequality or an additional close-location condition.
